keySentence: Three ghosts showed Scrooge his past and dark future.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Nobody was sad when Scrooge died. Tiny Tim was also dead. Scrooge begged for another chance. Three ghosts showed Scrooge his past and dark future.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The Ghost of Christmas Future showed a world without hope. When Scrooge died in the future, nobody shed a single tear. Little Tim had died too because his family had no money. Three ghosts showed Scrooge his past and dark future that night. Scrooge fell to his knees and begged for a chance to change. He finally understood that his greed had destroyed everything.
